Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the task by assuming Halliburton was the "other corporation" criticized by Scott Parkin alongside ExxonMobil without confirming this information through credible sources. This assumption led the subsequent steps to focus on Halliburton’s operations, ignoring the possibility of other corporations being the correct answer. This foundational error set the trajectory for the wrong solution to the real-world problem.
